objects.label: rising bubble column
objects.notes: an extended vertical source from the seabed (y 0) to the bell (y 21). Bound as a line.

objects.label: pod membrane
objects.notes: week 1: a first agent, from scratch. A breathing, permeable membrane the listener swims through. Silent in itself; its voice is the attractor inside it.

objects.label: the bell of the jellyfish
objects.notes: final project: three ideas. A breathing, permeable membrane the listener swims through. Silent in itself; its voice is the attractor inside it.

environment.setting: deep under water, inside one vast slow jellyfish made of drifting light
environment.enclosure: open water, 33 m out from a central column, sand dunes below, a bell at 21 m. No walls, surface or air.
environment.notes: Threejs frame, +Y up, camera looks down -Z, metres. The listener swims freely in three dimensions. Pods are permeable membranes, not walls: nothing occludes.

events.name: pod_enter
events.description: the listener passes through a membrane into a pod; fired at the pod's centre

events.name: pod_leave
events.description: the listener passes out of a pod; fired at the pod's centre

events.name: bell_enter
events.description: the listener arrives inside the bell; fired at the bell's centre

events.name: bell_leave
events.description: the listener leaves the bell; fired at the bell's centre

events.name: bud_stir
events.description: the listener comes close to a sleeping bud; fired at the bud

events.name: attractor_pass
events.description: the listener brushes right past an attractor; fired at it

events.name: glide_start
events.description: the listener is carried off along a curve (a teleport or a trip to a room); at the listener

events.name: glide_end
events.description: the glide sets the listener down; at the listener

events.name: sprint
events.description: a burst of speed begins; at the listener

events.name: seabed_touch
events.description: the listener reaches the sand; fired on the sand beneath them

events.name: ceiling_touch
events.description: the listener reaches the top of the water; fired just above them

events.name: edge_touch
events.description: the listener reaches the edge of the world, 33 m out; fired just beyond them

events.name: page_open
events.description: a page opens to be read; fired at the listener

events.name: page_close
events.description: the page closes; fired at the listener

events.name: menu_open
events.description: the rooms menu opens; non-spatial, at the listener

events.name: menu_close
events.description: the rooms menu closes; non-spatial, at the listener

events.name: sound_on
events.description: sound starts, on the visitor's first press; non-spatial, at the listener

events.name: ui_hover
events.description: pointer over an interface control; non-spatial, at the listener

events.name: ui_press
events.description: an interface control is pressed; non-spatial, at the listener

states.name: reading
states.description: a page is open over the world: everything ducks and dulls

signals.name: ascent
signals.description: how high the listener has swum
signals.unit: 0 at the seabed, 1 at the bell

signals.name: far
signals.description: how far out the listener is, of 33 m
signals.unit: 0 at the column, 1 at the edge of the world

signals.name: warmth
signals.unit: 0 far from any attractor, 1 beside one

signals.name: swell
signals.description: one very slow irregular wave, the one the whole world wobbles on
